091  @Test
092  public void testException() throws IOException {
093    NameBytesPair.Builder builder = NameBytesPair.newBuilder();
094    final String omg = "OMG!!!";
095    builder.setName("java.io.IOException");
096    builder.setValue(ByteString.copyFrom(Bytes.toBytes(omg)));
097    Throwable t = ProtobufUtil.toException(builder.build());
098    assertEquals(omg, t.getMessage());
099    builder.clear();
100    builder.setName("org.apache.hadoop.ipc.RemoteException");
101    builder.setValue(ByteString.copyFrom(Bytes.toBytes(omg)));
102    t = ProtobufUtil.toException(builder.build());
103    assertEquals(omg, t.getMessage());
104  }

111  public void testGet() throws IOException {
112    ClientProtos.Get.Builder getBuilder = ClientProtos.Get.newBuilder();
113    getBuilder.setRow(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("row"));
114    Column.Builder columnBuilder = Column.newBuilder();
115    columnBuilder.setFamily(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("f1"));
116    columnBuilder.addQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c1"));
117    columnBuilder.addQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c2"));
118    getBuilder.addColumn(columnBuilder.build());
119
120    columnBuilder.clear();
121    columnBuilder.setFamily(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("f2"));
122    getBuilder.addColumn(columnBuilder.build());
123    getBuilder.setLoadColumnFamiliesOnDemand(true);
124    ClientProtos.Get proto = getBuilder.build();
125    // default fields
126    assertEquals(1, proto.getMaxVersions());
127    assertEquals(true, proto.getCacheBlocks());
128
129    // set the default value for equal comparison
130    getBuilder = ClientProtos.Get.newBuilder(proto);
131    getBuilder.setMaxVersions(1);
132    getBuilder.setCacheBlocks(true);
133    getBuilder.setTimeRange(ProtobufUtil.toTimeRange(TimeRange.allTime()));
134    getBuilder.setQueryMetricsEnabled(false);
135    Get get = ProtobufUtil.toGet(proto);
136    assertEquals(getBuilder.build(), ProtobufUtil.toGet(get));
137  }

139  @Test
140  public void testEmptyResultWithQueryMetrics() throws IOException {
141    long blockBytesScanned = 123L;
142    for (Boolean exists : Arrays.asList(null, false, true)) {
143      Result result = Result.create(Collections.emptyList(), exists);
144      result.setMetrics(new QueryMetrics(blockBytesScanned));
145
146      for (ClientProtos.Result proto : List.of(ProtobufUtil.toResult(result),
147        ProtobufUtil.toResultNoData(result))) {
148        assertEquals(exists, proto.hasExists() ? proto.getExists() : null);
149        assertTrue(proto.hasMetrics());
150        assertEquals(blockBytesScanned, proto.getMetrics().getBlockBytesScanned());
151
152        Result roundTrip = ProtobufUtil.toResult(proto);
153        assertEquals(exists, roundTrip.getExists());
154        assertNotNull(roundTrip.getMetrics());
155        assertEquals(blockBytesScanned, roundTrip.getMetrics().getBlockBytesScanned());
156
157        roundTrip = ProtobufUtil.toResult(proto,
158          PrivateCellUtil.createExtendedCellScanner(Collections.<ExtendedCell> emptyList()));
159        assertEquals(exists, roundTrip.getExists());
160        assertNotNull(roundTrip.getMetrics());
161        assertEquals(blockBytesScanned, roundTrip.getMetrics().getBlockBytesScanned());
162      }
163    }
164
165    ClientProtos.Result emptyProto = ClientProtos.Result.getDefaultInstance();
166    assertNull(ProtobufUtil.toResult(emptyProto).getMetrics());
167    assertNull(ProtobufUtil
168      .toResult(emptyProto,
169        PrivateCellUtil.createExtendedCellScanner(Collections.<ExtendedCell> emptyList()))
170      .getMetrics());
171  }

173  /**
174   * Test Delete Mutate conversions.
175   * @throws IOException if the conversion to a {@link Delete} or a
176   *                     {@link org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Mutation} fails
177   */
178  @Test
179  public void testDelete() throws IOException {
180    MutationProto.Builder mutateBuilder = MutationProto.newBuilder();
181    mutateBuilder.setRow(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("row"));
182    mutateBuilder.setMutateType(MutationType.DELETE);
183    mutateBuilder.setTimestamp(111111);
184    ColumnValue.Builder valueBuilder = ColumnValue.newBuilder();
185    valueBuilder.setFamily(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("f1"));
186    QualifierValue.Builder qualifierBuilder = QualifierValue.newBuilder();
187    qualifierBuilder.setQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c1"));
188    qualifierBuilder.setDeleteType(DeleteType.DELETE_ONE_VERSION);
189    qualifierBuilder.setTimestamp(111222);
190    valueBuilder.addQualifierValue(qualifierBuilder.build());
191    qualifierBuilder.setQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c2"));
192    qualifierBuilder.setDeleteType(DeleteType.DELETE_MULTIPLE_VERSIONS);
193    qualifierBuilder.setTimestamp(111333);
194    valueBuilder.addQualifierValue(qualifierBuilder.build());
195    mutateBuilder.addColumnValue(valueBuilder.build());
196
197    MutationProto proto = mutateBuilder.build();
198    // default fields
199    assertEquals(MutationProto.Durability.USE_DEFAULT, proto.getDurability());
200
201    // set the default value for equal comparison
202    mutateBuilder = MutationProto.newBuilder(proto);
203    mutateBuilder.setDurability(MutationProto.Durability.USE_DEFAULT);
204
205    Delete delete = ProtobufUtil.toDelete(proto);
206
207    // delete always have empty value,
208    // add empty value to the original mutate
209    for (ColumnValue.Builder column : mutateBuilder.getColumnValueBuilderList()) {
210      for (QualifierValue.Builder qualifier : column.getQualifierValueBuilderList()) {
211        qualifier.setValue(ByteString.EMPTY);
212      }
213    }
214    assertEquals(mutateBuilder.build(), ProtobufUtil.toMutation(MutationType.DELETE, delete));
215  }

217  /**
218   * Test Put Mutate conversions.
219   * @throws IOException if the conversion to a {@link Put} or a
220   *                     {@link org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Mutation} fails
221   */
222  @Test
223  public void testPut() throws IOException {
224    MutationProto.Builder mutateBuilder = MutationProto.newBuilder();
225    mutateBuilder.setRow(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("row"));
226    mutateBuilder.setMutateType(MutationType.PUT);
227    mutateBuilder.setTimestamp(111111);
228    ColumnValue.Builder valueBuilder = ColumnValue.newBuilder();
229    valueBuilder.setFamily(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("f1"));
230    QualifierValue.Builder qualifierBuilder = QualifierValue.newBuilder();
231    qualifierBuilder.setQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c1"));
232    qualifierBuilder.setValue(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("v1"));
233    valueBuilder.addQualifierValue(qualifierBuilder.build());
234    qualifierBuilder.setQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c2"));
235    qualifierBuilder.setValue(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("v2"));
236    qualifierBuilder.setTimestamp(222222);
237    valueBuilder.addQualifierValue(qualifierBuilder.build());
238    mutateBuilder.addColumnValue(valueBuilder.build());
239
240    MutationProto proto = mutateBuilder.build();
241    // default fields
242    assertEquals(MutationProto.Durability.USE_DEFAULT, proto.getDurability());
243
244    // set the default value for equal comparison
245    mutateBuilder = MutationProto.newBuilder(proto);
246    mutateBuilder.setDurability(MutationProto.Durability.USE_DEFAULT);
247
248    Put put = ProtobufUtil.toPut(proto);
249
250    // put value always use the default timestamp if no
251    // value level timestamp specified,
252    // add the timestamp to the original mutate
253    long timestamp = put.getTimestamp();
254    for (ColumnValue.Builder column : mutateBuilder.getColumnValueBuilderList()) {
255      for (QualifierValue.Builder qualifier : column.getQualifierValueBuilderList()) {
256        if (!qualifier.hasTimestamp()) {
257          qualifier.setTimestamp(timestamp);
258        }
259      }
260    }
261    assertEquals(mutateBuilder.build(), ProtobufUtil.toMutation(MutationType.PUT, put));
262  }

267   */
268  @Test
269  public void testScan() throws IOException {
270    ClientProtos.Scan.Builder scanBuilder = ClientProtos.Scan.newBuilder();
271    scanBuilder.setStartRow(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("row1"));
272    scanBuilder.setStopRow(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("row2"));
273    Column.Builder columnBuilder = Column.newBuilder();
274    columnBuilder.setFamily(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("f1"));
275    columnBuilder.addQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c1"));
276    columnBuilder.addQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c2"));
277    scanBuilder.addColumn(columnBuilder.build());
278
279    columnBuilder.clear();
280    columnBuilder.setFamily(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("f2"));
281    scanBuilder.addColumn(columnBuilder.build());
282
283    ClientProtos.Scan proto = scanBuilder.build();
284
285    // Verify default values
286    assertEquals(1, proto.getMaxVersions());
287    assertEquals(true, proto.getCacheBlocks());
288
289    // Verify fields survive ClientProtos.Scan -> Scan -> ClientProtos.Scan
290    // conversion
291    scanBuilder = ClientProtos.Scan.newBuilder(proto);
292    scanBuilder.setMaxVersions(2);
293    scanBuilder.setCacheBlocks(false);
294    scanBuilder.setCaching(1024);
295    scanBuilder.setTimeRange(ProtobufUtil.toTimeRange(TimeRange.allTime()));
296    scanBuilder.setIncludeStopRow(false);
297    scanBuilder.setQueryMetricsEnabled(false);
298    ClientProtos.Scan expectedProto = scanBuilder.build();
299
300    ClientProtos.Scan actualProto = ProtobufUtil.toScan(ProtobufUtil.toScan(expectedProto));
301    assertEquals(expectedProto, actualProto);
302  }

304  @Test
305  public void testToCell() {
306    KeyValue kv1 =
307      new KeyValue(Bytes.toBytes("aaa"), Bytes.toBytes("f1"), Bytes.toBytes("q1"), new byte[30]);
308    KeyValue kv2 =
309      new KeyValue(Bytes.toBytes("bbb"), Bytes.toBytes("f1"), Bytes.toBytes("q1"), new byte[30]);
310    KeyValue kv3 =
311      new KeyValue(Bytes.toBytes("ccc"), Bytes.toBytes("f1"), Bytes.toBytes("q1"), new byte[30]);
312    byte[] arr = new byte[kv1.getLength() + kv2.getLength() + kv3.getLength()];
313    System.arraycopy(kv1.getBuffer(), kv1.getOffset(), arr, 0, kv1.getLength());
314    System.arraycopy(kv2.getBuffer(), kv2.getOffset(), arr, kv1.getLength(), kv2.getLength());
315    System.arraycopy(kv3.getBuffer(), kv3.getOffset(), arr, kv1.getLength() + kv2.getLength(),
316      kv3.getLength());
317    ByteBuffer dbb = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(arr.length);
318    dbb.put(arr);
319    ByteBufferKeyValue offheapKV = new ByteBufferKeyValue(dbb, kv1.getLength(), kv2.getLength());
320    CellProtos.Cell cell = ProtobufUtil.toCell(offheapKV, false);
321    Cell newOffheapKV = ProtobufUtil
322      .toCell(ExtendedCellBuilderFactory.create(CellBuilderType.SHALLOW_COPY), cell, false);
323    assertTrue(CellComparatorImpl.COMPARATOR.compare(offheapKV, newOffheapKV) == 0);
324  }

326  /**
327   * Test Increment Mutate conversions.
328   * @throws IOException if converting to an {@link Increment} or
329   *                     {@link org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Mutation} fails
330   */
331  @Test
332  public void testIncrement() throws IOException {
333
334    MutationProto proto = getIncrementMutation(111111L);
335    // default fields
336    assertEquals(MutationProto.Durability.USE_DEFAULT, proto.getDurability());
337
338    // set the default value for equal comparison
339    MutationProto.Builder mutateBuilder = MutationProto.newBuilder(proto);
340    mutateBuilder.setDurability(MutationProto.Durability.USE_DEFAULT);
341
342    Increment increment = ProtobufUtil.toIncrement(proto, null);
343    mutateBuilder.setTimestamp(increment.getTimestamp());
344    mutateBuilder.setTimeRange(ProtobufUtil.toTimeRange(increment.getTimeRange()));
345    assertEquals(mutateBuilder.build(), ProtobufUtil.toMutation(MutationType.INCREMENT, increment));
346  }

348  private MutationProto getIncrementMutation(Long timestamp) {
349    MutationProto.Builder mutateBuilder = MutationProto.newBuilder();
350    mutateBuilder.setRow(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("row"));
351    mutateBuilder.setMutateType(MutationProto.MutationType.INCREMENT);
352    ColumnValue.Builder valueBuilder = ColumnValue.newBuilder();
353    valueBuilder.setFamily(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("f1"));
354    QualifierValue.Builder qualifierBuilder = QualifierValue.newBuilder();
355    qualifierBuilder.setQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c1"));
356    qualifierBuilder.setValue(ByteString.copyFrom(Bytes.toBytes(11L)));
357
358    if (timestamp != null) {
359      qualifierBuilder.setTimestamp(timestamp);
360    }
361
362    valueBuilder.addQualifierValue(qualifierBuilder.build());
363    qualifierBuilder.setQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c2"));
364    qualifierBuilder.setValue(ByteString.copyFrom(Bytes.toBytes(22L)));
365    valueBuilder.addQualifierValue(qualifierBuilder.build());
366    mutateBuilder.addColumnValue(valueBuilder.build());
367
368    return mutateBuilder.build();
369  }

371  /**
372   * Older clients may not send along a timestamp in the MutationProto. Check that we default
373   * correctly.
374   */
375  @Test
376  public void testIncrementNoTimestamp() throws IOException {
377    MutationProto mutation = getIncrementMutation(null);
378    Increment increment = ProtobufUtil.toIncrement(mutation, null);
379    assertEquals(HConstants.LATEST_TIMESTAMP, increment.getTimestamp());
380    increment.getFamilyCellMap().values().forEach(cells -> cells
381      .forEach(cell -> assertEquals(HConstants.LATEST_TIMESTAMP, cell.getTimestamp())));
382  }

420  private MutationProto getAppendMutation(Long timestamp) {
421    MutationProto.Builder mutateBuilder = MutationProto.newBuilder();
422    mutateBuilder.setRow(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("row"));
423    mutateBuilder.setMutateType(MutationType.APPEND);
424    if (timestamp != null) {
425      mutateBuilder.setTimestamp(timestamp);
426    }
427    ColumnValue.Builder valueBuilder = ColumnValue.newBuilder();
428    valueBuilder.setFamily(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("f1"));
429    QualifierValue.Builder qualifierBuilder = QualifierValue.newBuilder();
430    qualifierBuilder.setQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c1"));
431    qualifierBuilder.setValue(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("v1"));
432    if (timestamp != null) {
433      qualifierBuilder.setTimestamp(timestamp);
434    }
435    valueBuilder.addQualifierValue(qualifierBuilder.build());
436    qualifierBuilder.setQualifier(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("c2"));
437    qualifierBuilder.setValue(ByteString.copyFromUtf8("v2"));
438    valueBuilder.addQualifierValue(qualifierBuilder.build());
439    mutateBuilder.addColumnValue(valueBuilder.build());
440
441    return mutateBuilder.build();
442  }

444  private static ProcedureProtos.Procedure.Builder createProcedureBuilder(long procId) {
445    ProcedureProtos.Procedure.Builder builder = ProcedureProtos.Procedure.newBuilder();
446    builder.setProcId(procId);
447    builder.setClassName("java.lang.Object");
448    builder.setSubmittedTime(0);
449    builder.setState(ProcedureProtos.ProcedureState.RUNNABLE);
450    builder.setLastUpdate(0);
451
452    return builder;
453  }
454
455  private static ProcedureProtos.Procedure createProcedure(long procId) {
456    return createProcedureBuilder(procId).build();
457  }

459  private static LockServiceProtos.LockedResource createLockedResource(
460    LockServiceProtos.LockedResourceType resourceType, String resourceName,
461    LockServiceProtos.LockType lockType, ProcedureProtos.Procedure exclusiveLockOwnerProcedure,
462    int sharedLockCount) {
463    LockServiceProtos.LockedResource.Builder build = LockServiceProtos.LockedResource.newBuilder();
464    build.setResourceType(resourceType);
465    build.setResourceName(resourceName);
466    build.setLockType(lockType);
467    if (exclusiveLockOwnerProcedure != null) {
468      build.setExclusiveLockOwnerProcedure(exclusiveLockOwnerProcedure);
469    }
470    build.setSharedLockCount(sharedLockCount);
471
472    return build.build();
473  }

475  @Test
476  public void testProcedureInfo() {
477    ProcedureProtos.Procedure.Builder builder = createProcedureBuilder(1);
478    ByteString stateBytes = ByteString.copyFrom(new byte[] { 65 });
479    BytesValue state = BytesValue.newBuilder().setValue(stateBytes).build();
480    builder.addStateMessage(Any.pack(state));
481    ProcedureProtos.Procedure procedure = builder.build();
482
483    String procJson = ProtobufUtil.toProcedureJson(Lists.newArrayList(procedure));
484    assertEquals("[{" + "\"className\":\"java.lang.Object\"," + "\"procId\":\"1\","
485      + "\"submittedTime\":\"0\"," + "\"state\":\"RUNNABLE\"," + "\"lastUpdate\":\"0\","
486      + "\"stateMessage\":[{\"value\":\"QQ==\"}]" + "}]", procJson);
487  }

539  /**
540   * Test {@link ProtobufUtil#toCell(ExtendedCell, boolean)} and
541   * {@link ProtobufUtil#toCell(ExtendedCellBuilder, CellProtos.Cell, boolean)} conversion methods
542   * when it contains tags and encode/decode tags is set to true.
543   */
544  @Test
545  public void testCellConversionWithTags() {
546    ExtendedCell cell = getCellWithTags();
547    CellProtos.Cell protoCell = ProtobufUtil.toCell(cell, true);
548    assertNotNull(protoCell);
549
550    ExtendedCell decodedCell = getCellFromProtoResult(protoCell, true);
551    List<Tag> decodedTags = PrivateCellUtil.getTags(decodedCell);
552    assertEquals(1, decodedTags.size());
553    Tag decodedTag = decodedTags.get(0);
554    assertEquals(TAG_TYPE, decodedTag.getType());
555    assertEquals(TAG_STR, Tag.getValueAsString(decodedTag));
556  }
557
558  private ExtendedCell getCellWithTags() {
559    Tag tag = new ArrayBackedTag(TAG_TYPE, TAG_STR);
560    ExtendedCellBuilder cellBuilder = ExtendedCellBuilderFactory.create(CellBuilderType.DEEP_COPY);
561    cellBuilder.setRow(Bytes.toBytes("row1"));
562    cellBuilder.setFamily(Bytes.toBytes("f1"));
563    cellBuilder.setQualifier(Bytes.toBytes("q1"));
564    cellBuilder.setValue(Bytes.toBytes("value1"));
565    cellBuilder.setType(Cell.Type.Delete);
566    cellBuilder.setTags(Collections.singletonList(tag));
567    return cellBuilder.build();
568  }
569
570  private ExtendedCell getCellFromProtoResult(CellProtos.Cell protoCell, boolean decodeTags) {
571    ExtendedCellBuilder decodedBuilder =
572      ExtendedCellBuilderFactory.create(CellBuilderType.DEEP_COPY);
573    return ProtobufUtil.toCell(decodedBuilder, protoCell, decodeTags);
574  }

624  /**
625   * Used to confirm that we only consider truncatedMessage as EOF
626   */
627  @Test
628  public void testIsEOF() throws Exception {
629    for (Method method : InvalidProtocolBufferException.class.getDeclaredMethods()) {
630      if (
631        method.getParameterCount() == 0
632          && method.getReturnType() == InvalidProtocolBufferException.class
633      ) {
634        method.setAccessible(true);
635        InvalidProtocolBufferException e = (InvalidProtocolBufferException) method.invoke(null);
636        assertEquals(method.getName().equals("truncatedMessage"), ProtobufUtil.isEOF(e));
637      }
638    }
639  }
